items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But anyway, we became great friends and remained that way until his death.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was working for NBC back in the forties. Back in the forties they were doing things called “Jubilee” and they would – we would make records – we would do concerts over here, and they would send it to the guys in the service, they sent it all around to the armed forces. So Jimmy Lyons was that man. So Jimmy – I did two with my big band, and I did one with – I had a small group for about a year and a seven-piece band. I did one with a seven-piece band for Jimmy Lyons. So I knew he was gonna call me some…

items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

ctx.x: See the trumpet players that he had, I’m going to tell you, I remember it was Miles Davis.
Miles was one of the ones he wanted to let out. The fellow that married Sarah Vaughan? What was his name?
